main_measure.name: |forecast|-weighted mean 7-bar directional excess return (short), short grid bars
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 days and supporting check passes; reject: t <= -2 over >= 30 days

supporting_check.name: mean excess of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: |t| < 2 over at least 30 days: the result is inconclusive.
reading: Days are UTC calendar days of the grid bar; the day-clustered t sums each day's weighted deviations; the larger half is the top floor(n/2) cases by |forecast| (ties in record order) with unweighted half means; 'near zero' is read as covered by the |t| < 2 rule, with no extra threshold.
